title: Horace Mann Expands Teacher Appreciation Week Into Month-Long Celebration With Over $25,000 in Support for Educators
summary: Horace Mann (NYSE:HMN) is proud to recognize and support educators nationwide through its annual Teacher Appreciation Month celebration, honoring the dedication and impact teachers make every day. The company’s “Beyond Grateful” campaign will run from April 29 – May 22, expanding beyond the traditional Teacher Appreciation Week (May 4 – 8) to provide educators with meaningful recognition and tangible support as they begin to close out the school year. “Our ‘Beyond Grateful’ campaign is about recognizing the incredible impact educators have on their students and communities,” said Katie Hamilton, Vice President of Marketing and Partnerships at Horace Mann. “Educators continue to go above and beyond for their students, often using their own time and resources, and this is one way we give back and show our appreciation.” Throughout the month, all educators can participate in multiple offerings, including: Weekly Sweepstakes: Educators can enter to win daily and weekly gift cards, as well
